configurations.name: Next.js (web, local Supabase)
runtimeArgs: eval "$(supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.anon_key=NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY | grep -E '^(NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL|NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)=' | sed 's/^/export /')" && export NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000 && exec pnpm --filter @da2/web dev

configurations.name: Next.js (web, local db)
runtimeArgs: eval "$(supabase status -o env --override-name api.url=NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL --override-name auth.anon_key=NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --override-name auth.service_role_key=SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY | sed 's/^/export /')" && pnpm --filter @da2/web dev -p 3100
